Sets the light channels a light shines into. A channel is one bit of `channel`, so there are 8 of them (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128) and the values add up: 3 is channel 1 and 2. A light only lights the entities that share at least one channel with it, see [EntityLightChannel](EntityLightChannel). The default is 255, all channels, so lights and entities that never use channels behave as before.

Lights that do not share a channel with an entity are left out before the 8 lights that light it are picked, so lights of other channels never use up one of its 8 (see [Many-Lights](Many-Lights)).

```blitzbasic
;media still blitz3d/lightchannel.png
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 0, 0, -9
AmbientLight 10, 10, 10
; A red light for channel 1 and a blue light for channel 2.
red = CreateLight(2)
PositionEntity red, 0, 3, -3
LightColor red, 255, 0, 0
LightChannel red, 1
blue = CreateLight(2)
PositionEntity blue, 0, 3, -3
LightColor blue, 0, 0, 255
LightChannel blue, 2
; The left ball is in channel 1, the middle one in channel 2 and the right one in both.
For i = 0 To 2
	ball = CreateSphere(24)
	PositionEntity ball, i * 3 - 3, 0, 0
	EntityLightChannel ball, i + 1
Next
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![LightChannel](media/blitz3d/lightchannel.png)

Without channels all three balls are lit by both lights and look the same (left), with them each ball only gets the light of its channels (right):

![LightChannel before and after](media/blitz3d/lightchannel_before_after.png)

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no light channels.
@param light    Light handle.
@param channel  The channels as bits (0 to 255): bit 0 is channel 1 up to bit 7 for channel 8.
